findings.explanation: PO-1005 is explicitly referenced by both the invoice and the receipt but no purchase order document exists in the evidence set, so the authorization for this 59,000 INR payment cannot be independently verified.

The receipt REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 dated 2026-07-21, an out-of-sequence ordering that warrants manual review though it can occur with goods-received-before-invoicing.
